author: Michaela Springer
title: Indiana Silver Alert canceled for missing 15-year-old from Crown Point - NewsBreak
text:
By Michaela Springer ,
17 hours ago
UPDATE: The Indiana Silver Alert for Elizabeth Granville has been canceled.
MERRILLVILLE, Ind. (WISH) — The Merrillville Police Department was seeking the public’s help finding a missing 15-year-old girl last seen Tuesday night.
Elizabeth Granville was described as a white female, 5 feet 2 inches tall, and 160 pounds, with brown hair and brown eyes. She was last seen wearing a black shirt, neon green shorts, and black shoes.
Granville was last seen in Crown Point around 9:30 p.m. Tuesday.
Police believe she is in extreme danger and may require medical attention.
Anyone with information on Granville was asked to contact Merrillville police at 219-660-0000 or 911.
—
Crown Point is 138 miles northwest of downtown Indianapolis.
